quarterly_data.signal: 20-F customer concentration (customers not named): sales to Sanofi's biggest customers, in particular certain US wholesalers, represented 36% of net sales in 2025; the three largest customers accounted for approximately 18%, 12% and 6% of net sales in 2025 (15%, 11% and 8% in 2024; 13%, 10% and 8% in 2023). The 20-F cites the concentrated US pharmaceutical distribution system as a specific customer credit risk; customers consist principally of wholesalers, distributors, pharmacies, hospitals, clinics and government agencies, and trade receivables overdue by more than 12 months (mainly public-sector bodies) rose from EUR 44 million to EUR 52 million at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: three largest customers approximately 18%, 12% and 6% of 2025 net sales; biggest customers 36% of net sales
